She is looking DIRECTLY INTO THE CAMERA with a friendly questioning expression, mouth slightly open as if asking the viewer who the referenced guest is. Her head and gaze face the viewer; her natural pointing hand or inclusive open-hand gesture indicates ONLY the one father, same tan overshirt white T-shirt dark jeans and face, standing on the wooden footbridge. Natural skin, anatomically sound connected arms and hands; no floating hands. The learner must immediately understand who is asking and who is being pointed to. No speech bubbles or text.
